d: The book "Digital Manga Composition & Perspective: A Guide for Comic Book Artists" is a practical guide for creating dynamic and visually striking illustrations for comics and manga. The main goal of the book is to teach you how to apply the fundamental principles of composition and perspective to make your drawings more expressive and powerful. The author, Rui Tomono, uses detailed examples to show you how to create captivating illustrations.
n: [Non-H] Digital Manga Composition & Perspective: A Guide for Comic Book Artists
